protocol.analysis_scope: 8 gains plus 6 adjacent-gain differences plus 2 endpoint differences, paired over five shared-data seeds. Validation descriptive because it selected checkpoints. Fresh-event uncertainty plan frozen separately before official catalog generation.
protocol.checkpoint_selection: Minimum source-validation original-unit mean NLL using float32 selection at update1/every500/final; export float32 event scores and float64 summary.

contexts.boundary: left-closed/right-open except final closed; exact p remains in center and support

contexts.name: Full5

protocol.equal_structure_boundary: Five input columns and equal nominal parameter counts do not imply equal active weights or effective model class: padded-zero input weights receive no data gradient.
protocol.fresh_evaluation_policy: All new80 training analysis and complete old160+new80 model union must be frozen before official new independent Geant4 catalog generation. Engineering smoke and timing are separate and not scientific evidence.
protocol.pairing: For each seed, identical model structure/initial weights across all contexts and representations; identical ordered subset and full minibatch-index trace across context/representation within fraction.

preprocessing.center: Raw zero; CorrectedPhysics frozen nominal all-MeV silicon center using exact p_in, thickness and charge. Quantization never changes center/support inputs.
preprocessing.mu: mean_subset(Y-center), per representation; same subset across contexts/seeds.
preprocessing.scale: population std_subset(Y), ddof=0, shared across representations and contexts.
preprocessing.subsets: first round(f*Ntrain) events ordered by SHA256(4101:event_uid), nested fractions.

protocol.previous_results_role: Historical robustness/reference only; no previous fit substitutes for a new equal-structure cell.
protocol.purpose: Test a nested neural-information ladder under identical five-column architecture while keeping true momentum in the target center and support. All 80 models are newly trained.
protocol.quantization_rationale: Equal-width 2 and 8 partitions of fixed physical range [0.3,1.0] GeV/c, strictly nested. Bin midpoints are a controlled coarse momentum-resolution proxy, not measured instrument resolution. Boundaries are fixed before these fits and are not tuned from their scores.
